recipes.patternName: Modular — as drawn 4E:1F (67% E / 33% F by area) · source mix differs

layout.jointNotes: Actual Permacon 2026 Ontario product guide PDF97 drawing, verified against all 63 complete source faces (no missing or extra stone, both extraction methods agreeing, perturbation controls rejected). The repeat as drawn is 4E:1F: 67% E / 33% F by area, 80% E / 20% F by pieces. The caption printed beside it reads "67% F + 33% E (stacked with "67% I + 33% H")", which does not describe this drawing; the drawn stones are used and the caption is not. Permacon states its laying patterns are shown by way of example. Nominal zero-joint topology of full published stock: no installed joint schedule, spacer detail or pack ratio is established.

blindReview.notes: Bands of 3 stacked lying stones with narrow uprights, then two bands of square + lying stones above and below + uprights on the sides, each band shifted one third of the 63 px period. The triple groups are triples in both. Every line position matches; the count is an estimate at this small size.
